answer: Each epoch each identity submits an original 400-word essay on a Comet Pool prompt drawn from 1,000, with a 20 POA bond locked 90 days; the Willow Ledger fingerprints it, and a Zephyr Audit flags any pair over 85% similar, slashing both bonds. Forging 100 identities needs 100 distinct essays, about 50 hours of writing, with bonds doubling per extra identity from one wallet to a 640 cap, totalling 61,420 POA. Verifiers replay fingerprints on-chain; two flags in 3 epochs freeze payouts. Shared household style may trip the audit, so a flagged identity may appeal once a year with a fresh essay.
